verdict.rationale: gstack ships many first-party 'skills' that generate AI insights and suggestions directly from the user's codebase/product data — security and SQL-safety review (gstack-docs-1, gstack-docs-6), auto-review pipelines with decision principles (gstack-docs-5), scored design/plan reviews (gstack-docs-19, gstack-docs-29), root-cause debugging analysis (gstack-docs-22), and startup/product framing questions (gstack-docs-4, gstack-docs-27). Community evidence corroborates real-world value ('dramatically improved code quality', gstack-comm-1) and highlights the specialist-persona pattern (gstack-comm-3). Missing for 10: independent benchmark of insight/suggestion accuracy and broader non-code data sources beyond repo/browsing context.
